explication: Centaur is a self-hosted shared-agent platform: users start conversations through Slack or the API, the control plane manages durable sessions and assigns isolated sandboxes, and harnesses execute work with approved tools. Results and progress return through the initiating channel. The repository also includes durable workflows, credential-protected outbound access, team-facing configuration, and integrations such as GitHub. Relationships below follow explicit README descriptions or sampled imports/calls; unsampled subsystem details are represented at their enclosing directory where appropriate.
